event.description: Reduce interleaved model feed-forward width from 8 to 4
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 3,488 parameters at 99.630000%, a +0.630000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 5 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0009, ff_dim=8 at 3,488 parameters and 99.63% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0001, an optimization failure under the superseded separated-token representation with no official score. Hypothesis: a 4D nonlinear bottleneck may still encode the small carry-state computation while attention preserves the 16D residual stream; reducing ff_dim 8->4 is parameterization-preserving compression removing 256 parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=6 because halving establishes a clear bottleneck boundary after width 8 required the full 45,000-step schedule and achieved only 99.58% on the existing internal test checkpoint. The 20,000-step below-50% stalled-run gate remains fixed.
